[build-system]
requires = ["hatchling>=1.25"]
build-backend = "hatchling.build"

[project]
name = "notes"
version = "2.3.1"
description = "A small Flask API and site for personal notes"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.12"
dependencies = [
    "flask==3.1.3",
    "werkzeug>=3.1,<4",
    "markupsafe>=2.1.1",
]

[dependency-groups]
dev = [
    "pytest>=8",
]

[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel]
packages = ["src/notes"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]

"""The application factory."""

from flask import Flask

from notes.api import api
from notes.filters import register_filters
from notes.json_support import NotesJSONProvider
from notes.pages import pages
from notes.store import NoteStore, seed_notes


def create_app(config: dict | None = None) -> Flask:
    app = Flask(__name__)
    app.config.update(SECRET_KEY="notes-dev", SEED=True)
    if config:
        app.config.update(config)
    app.json = NotesJSONProvider(app)

    store = NoteStore()
    app.extensions["notes_store"] = store
    app.register_blueprint(api)
    app.register_blueprint(pages)
    register_filters(app)

    @app.before_request
    def seed() -> None:
        if app.config["SEED"] and store.is_empty():
            seed_notes(store)

    return app

"""The HTML pages: the list and one note.""" from flask import Blueprint, abort, current_app, render_template_string from markupsafe import Markup, escape from notes.store import NoteStore pages = Blueprint("pages", __name__) LIST_PAGE = """ Notes

Notes

    {% for note in notes %}
  • {{ note|tagline }}
    • {% endfor %}

{{ count }} note(s)

""" NOTE_PAGE = """ {{ note.title }}

{{ note.title }}

{{ note.created.isoformat() }} · {{ tags }}

{{ body }}
""" def store() -> NoteStore: return current_app.extensions["notes_store"] def render_body(body: str) -> Markup: """Paragraphs separated by blank lines, every line escaped.""" paragraphs = [part for part in body.split("\n\n") if part.strip()] return Markup("".join(f"

{'
'.join(escape(line) for line in part.splitlines())}

" for part in paragraphs)) @pages.get("/") def index(): notes = store().all() return render_template_string(LIST_PAGE, notes=notes, count=len(notes)) @pages.get("/notes/") def show(note_id: int): note = store().get(note_id) if note is None: abort(404) return render_template_string(NOTE_PAGE, note=note, tags=", ".join(sorted(note.tags)), body=render_body(note.body))

"""Slugs and safe file names for notes."""

import re
import unicodedata
from urllib.parse import quote

from werkzeug.utils import safe_join

EXPORT_FOLDER = "exports"


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    """``"Café notes!"`` -> ``"cafe-notes"``."""
    ascii_text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", title).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode()
    slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", ascii_text.lower()).strip("-")
    return slug or "note"


def quoted_slug(title: str) -> str:
    """The slug as it appears in a URL (percent-encoded, though slugs rarely need it)."""
    return quote(slugify(title))


def export_filename(title: str) -> str:
    """``exports/<slug>.txt``, refusing anything that would leave the export folder."""
    path = safe_join(EXPORT_FOLDER, f"{slugify(title)}.txt")
    if path is None:
        raise ValueError("unsafe export name")
    return path
